ironmall_intro._note: Start of an Iron Mall run: the Mayor radios in. Event foe_arrives = the Sentinel gunship pulls up.

hail.text: {ship}, this is the Iron Mall! Captain, do you read me? Your signal just died on us!

options.text: We read you. Sentinels jumped us – we barely got out.

crew.text: Thank God… Who's still with you?

options.text: {crew}. The others… I don't know where they are.

crate.text: We'll find them. But the crate – tell me you still have the crate.

options.text: It's in the hold. What the hell is in there?
We nearly died for that thing. Talk.

pause.text: A P.A.U.S.E. unit. Prometheus Atomic. It can stop time itself – every Sentinel in the wasteland wants it.

options.text: Stop time…? Mayor, we've got company. Sentinel ship, closing in!

fight.text: Then fight! Power up your guns and hit their weapons room. If it gets ugly – use the P.A.U.S.E.
